name: _lists.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  cms/_lists.scss — list-shaped editors: paragraph, channel/link,
//  mention, section-card and media-item rows, plus the cover layout,
//  key/value list, and checkbox controls.
//  Imported by cms.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── Paragraph List Editor ─────────────────────────────────────────────
.cms-para-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
}

.cms-para-item {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  align-items: flex-start;

  textarea {
    flex: 1;
  }
}

.cms-para-controls {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-2xs);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

// ── Channel / Link List Editor ─────────────────────────────────────────
.cms-channel-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
}

.cms-channel-item {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: to-rem(130px) 1fr auto;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  align-items: center;
}

.cms-channel-label {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.cms-input--label {
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}

.cms-item-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.cms-item-label {
  font-weight: 600;
  color: $cms-accent;
}

.cms-item-controls {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-2xs);
}

// ── Mention Items ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.cms-mention-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
}

.cms-mention-item {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

// ── Section Card ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.cms-section-card {
  border-left: var(--space-3xs) solid $cms-accent;
}

.cms-sections-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-md);
}

// ── Media Item ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.cms-media-item {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding: var(--space-sm);
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.cms-media-thumb {
  width: to-rem(72px);
  height: to-rem(44px);
  object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  border: var(--space-3xs) solid $cms-border;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.cms-media-thumb-placeholder {
  width: to-rem(72px);
  height: to-rem(44px);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  background: $cms-bg-darker;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: var(--space-xl);
  border: var(--space-3xs) dashed $cms-border;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.cms-media-fields {
  flex: 1;
}

// ── Cover Layout ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.cms-cover-layout {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-lg);
  align-items: flex-start;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.cms-cover-thumb {
  width: to-rem(120px);
  height: to-rem(72px);
  object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: var(--space-3xs) solid $cms-border;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.cms-cover-fields {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: to-rem(280px);
}

// ── Key/Value List Editor (Playground labels, route slugs) ────────────
.cms-kv-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
}

.cms-kv-item {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(to-rem(160px), to-rem(220px)) 1fr auto;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  align-items: center;
}

.cms-kv-key {
  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: $cms-accent;
  word-break: break-all;
}

// ── Checkbox ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Bare toggle used inside kv rows (playground defaults) where a wrapping
// label would break the grid.
.cms-checkbox {
  width: var(--space-md);
  height: var(--space-md);
  accent-color: $cms-accent;
  cursor: pointer;
  justify-self: start;
}

.cms-checkbox-label {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  color: $cms-text-primary;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  cursor: pointer;

  input[type='checkbox'] {
    width: var(--space-md);
    height: var(--space-md);
    accent-color: $cms-accent;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
}
